user.title: Connect Spooly
user.description: Create the key in Spooly under Settings, Devices & keys. The integration only reads and never changes anything in Spooly.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only change this if you are working against a test environment.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter a new key
reauth_confirm.description: Spooly rejected the key. It was probably revoked. Create a new one in Spooly and enter it here.

error.invalid_auth: The key is wrong or has been revoked.
error.pro_expired: Spooly Pro has expired. The key works again once Pro is active.
error.api_disabled: The API is not enabled for your account yet.
error.rate_limited: You have reached today's limit of calls. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Spooly cannot be reached. Check the internet connection.
error.invalid_url: The address must start with https://.
error.unknown: Spooly answered unexpectedly. Details are in the log.

abort.already_configured: This key is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new key has been saved.

pro_expired.message: Spooly Pro has expired. Values stay as they are and return once Pro is active.

api_disabled.message: The API is not enabled for your Spooly account.

rate_limited.message: Spooly has limited requests for now. The next attempt follows later.
